title: Does Gender Matter? The Effect of Management Responses on Reviewing Behavior
near_miss_reason: Every reported DiD column (Table 3 columns 1-2, Table 9) adds review-level time-varying controls (positive_review, demean_logWC = demeaned log review length), a treated-group linear trend (trend:treated), and an additional traveler-segment fixed effect (traveled_as); Table 3 column 2 and Table 9 also add treatment-by-subgroup interactions. No column reports the plain after + hotel FE + year-month FE specification.
eligible_reason: Design qualifies (binary 'after' switches on when a hotel posts its first management response; 146 distinct adoption months 2003-2016; 1,395 never-responding hotels; after is monotone within hotel), but no main-text column is free of time-varying controls, the treated x trend term and the extra FE. Recorded as near-miss.
design_notes: Review-level repeated cross-section (2,028,872 TripAdvisor reviews, 5,413 hotels, 4,018 treated) assigned to hotels; outcome is_woman_disclosed (reviewer self-identifies as female). Treatment after = review posted after the hotel's first management response (min_response_date). FE: hotel_id + year_month (+ traveled_as). Cluster hotel_id. Estimated with lfe::felm. Table 4 uses within-treated response visibility (not DiD). Appendix: event-study version (interval dummies) with the same controls, alternative gender measures, hotel-specific trends.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: distinct year-months of first management response among treated hotels (from ta-final.csv.gz min_response_date)

specs.exclusion_reason: time-varying controls (positive_review, demean_logWC), treated x linear trend, extra traveled_as FE
specs.treatment_definition: review date >= hotel's first management response date (0 for never-responding hotels)
specs.notes: Near-miss base specification; dropping controls/trend/traveled_as would give the eligible TWFE.

specs.exclusion_reason: subgroup-by-treatment interactions plus the controls above
triple interactions with cumulative contentious responses plus controls

software_notes: R (lfe::felm, data.table); one Stata do-file for appendix Table 12.
screener_notes: Project-member paper (Davide Proserpio). Near-miss: a controls-free TWFE could be constructed from ta-final.csv.gz (is_woman_disclosed ~ after | hotel_id + year_month, cluster hotel_id) for the secondary category. Screened from package only.
eligible_design_note: set to false Nov 1 ~22:05 (coding rule, PROTOCOL 5b): near-miss with no main-text specification satisfying every design rule
